_comment: Editorial content. Numbers here are NOT auto-refreshed. Each block carries its own as_of date and the dashboard prints it, so stale commentary is visible rather than silently wrong.

cards: 56% of all stablecoin value, over 65% counting L2s. 27.1m holders.
Past $38B on 6 Aug, growing about 30% a quarter. Excludes stablecoins.
Roughly 57% of issuer TVL. BlackRock, JPMorgan and Amundi funds sit here.
Ten straight days in late August, over $1B of it BlackRock's ETHA.
adoption.caveat: Messari's August read found Ethereum's fundamentals close to flat — tokenized RWA value +2.1%, stablecoin supply +0.2%, application revenue +1.6%, transactions −3.2%. Unique active addresses (+7.7%) were the only mover. Flows recovered; usage didn't.

treasury_note.text: Accumulation was ferocious through August 2025, then essentially stopped. Whatever is driving the equity's rerating, it is not the company buying more ether.
